provenance.abstraction_rationale: The single affected API is torch.batch_norm_update_stats. The historical failure is scoped to an empty-input call path, with patch evidence showing CPU and CUDA update paths added an empty-input guard before a division.
unresolved_information: No explicit root-cause statement was mapped in reported_diagnosis; defect_mechanism is inferred from patch evidence.
No explicit expected behavior was mapped.
No explicit historical oracle was mapped.

historical_conditions.statement: An invocation of torch.batch_norm_update_stats used an input tensor with shape [0,0], running_mean and running_var tensors with shape [1], and momentum=0.0.

defect_mechanism.description: The CPU and CUDA batch_norm_update_stats implementations computed n = input.numel() / n_input without first rejecting zero-element inputs. For an input of shape [0,0], n_input is 0, so the division by zero produced a floating point exception. The fix adds TORCH_CHECK(input.numel() != 0) before that division in both paths.

observed_failure.description: Calling torch.batch_norm_update_stats with an empty input tensor of shape [0,0] produced a floating point exception (core dumped).

historical_observations.statement: The issue was reported as reproducible on Linux (Ubuntu), but not on Mac M1.
